description: The second season broadens the anthology through time travel, virtual minds, alien occupation, genetic engineering and apocalyptic choices, repeatedly asking how much humanity survives when technology rewrites ordinary life.

s02e01.description: An FBI agent investigates a series of executions linked to the same gun across decades and uncovers a time-travel mechanism behind murders that should have been impossible.

s02e02.description: After biological war eliminates humanity, two androids secretly raise a cloned human while hiding him from machines determined to prevent the species from returning.

s02e03.description: Expectant parents consider illegal genetic enhancement for their unborn child, only to discover that the promise of perfection can produce consequences no screening brochure mentions.

s02e04.description: A reporter pursuing the disappearance of a controversial author encounters violet-eyed strangers and bodies reduced to ash, drawing her into a hidden conflict.

s02e05.description: A doctor uses virtual-reality technology to enter the mind of a comatose colleague, where subjective reality proves far more dangerous than a medical procedure should be.

s02e06.description: A man haunted by memories of alien abduction enters a treatment centre for people with similar experiences and begins to suspect the institution is concealing more than trauma therapy.

s02e07.description: A man celebrating his first wedding anniversary develops inexplicable revulsion toward his seemingly perfect wife and starts questioning whether the woman he married is what she appears to be.

s02e08.description: Students at a strict academy discover that its celebrated success at curing rebellion relies on brain implants and a much darker political purpose.

s02e09.description: A newly inaugurated US president must decide whether an approaching alien fleet comes in peace or represents an existential threat, with almost no reliable information.

s02e10.description: An astronaut missing for twenty years contacts Earth from an alien world where only minutes have passed, creating a rescue opportunity through an unstable wormhole.

s02e11.description: A traveller lost in a snowstorm reaches a refuge whose residents claim the world is frozen, but their shifting personalities make the sanctuary increasingly suspect.

s02e12.description: A physics professor believes humanity has only hours left before catastrophe and finally acts on years of unspoken love, while keeping the reason for his sudden urgency secret.

s02e13.description: Ancient parasites unearthed beneath a town invade human brains and trigger violent madness, leaving an unlikely young resident as the key to stopping the outbreak.

s02e14.description: A militia expecting stolen weapons receives a sealed cargo containing something far stranger, and an alien life-form turns the planned heist into a fight for survival.

s02e15.description: A condemned soldier accepts an experimental injection of alien DNA in place of execution, gains extraordinary abilities and escapes while fighting to remain human.

s02e16.description: In an alien-occupied future, rebels deprogram a human servant conditioned to obey the invaders and send him back against his former master with disastrous consequences.

s02e17.description: A doctor investigating young women who age and die within hours finds a connection to elderly patients disappearing from a care facility and a dangerous promise of youth.

s02e18.description: A radiation-poisoned crew continues a desperate mission against an alien home world, with Major Skokes again confronting the enemy from Quality of Mercy.

s02e19.description: A fan from the future saves a suicidal pop star, only for other time travellers to insist that history requires the singer to die.

s02e20.description: A scientist's consciousness leaves her body during an experiment and becomes trapped outside it, forcing her to communicate before someone else controls the situation permanently.

s02e21.description: After a minor accident, a man discovers that ten years have passed for everyone except him and must understand why his life is advancing in impossible jumps.

s02e22.description: The inventor of a virtual prison designed to compress years of punishment into hours is forced to experience his own system when an innocent life depends on it.
